request.style: English, lovers rock reggae, smooth one drop, warm bass, organ and offbeat piano, a sweet female lead with male harmony, gentle and loving, 74 BPM
request.lyrics:

Bless those who persecute you
Bless and do not curse
Rejoice with those who rejoice

Live in peace with everyone
Do not be overcome by evil

Do not be proud, but walk with the lowly
Never repay evil for evil
If your enemy is hungry, feed him

[Chorus]
If it is possible, as far as it depends on you
Live in peace with everyone
Do not be overcome by evil
